program.merge_policy: accumulate eight 25-finding passes; consolidate, admit, validate, and merge once after 200

policy.validation_strategy: cheap duplicate/entity screening during authoring; expensive repository-wide validation only after Wave 500

waves.focus: Six-week randomized placebo-controlled Crocus sativus stigma-extract trial in mild-to-moderate depression; preserve extract identity, short duration, and diagnosis boundary.
Small double-blind GAD trial versus oxazepam; comparable symptom improvement with slower onset in the trial, but small sample and comparator design prevent broad equivalence claims.
Standardized SHR-5 randomized trial in stress-related fatigue; preserve extract identity and fatigue-context boundary.
2025 12-week randomized trial in 101 healthy adults testing Bacumen for cognition, stress and fatigue; proprietary extract and healthy-population limits retained.
Randomized double-blind placebo-controlled trial in 90 Korean volunteers with mild cognitive impairment; MCI-specific cognition evidence, not healthy nootropic evidence.
Four-week randomized crossover trial in healthy adults; selected stress-related and cognitive outcomes, with isolated-theanine and chronic-exposure boundaries.
2025 randomized placebo-controlled trial in 155 adults with self-reported poor sleep; magnesium-bisglycinate/formulation-specific sleep evidence.
Four-week randomized trial of fast-release melatonin in middle-aged adults with primary insomnia; formulation, age, duration and insomnia-diagnosis boundaries retained.
10-week randomized trial in 539 adults with GAD comparing Silexan doses, placebo and paroxetine; Silexan-specific oral lavender evidence.
Randomized placebo-controlled Matricaria recutita extract trial in mild-to-moderate GAD; preliminary diagnosis- and extract-specific evidence.
Eight-week randomized double-blind placebo-controlled trial in major depressive disorder; curcumin regimen and psychiatric-population boundaries retained.
Large randomized trial in major depressive episodes; overall primary analysis only trended toward benefit while a prespecified non-anxious subgroup improved, so no uniform antidepressant claim.
Eight-week randomized trial of creatine augmentation of escitalopram in women with MDD; adjunctive, sex-specific psychiatric evidence.
Small randomized crossover pilot in older adults with chronic insomnia; some subjective benefits but several objective sleep outcomes did not differ from placebo.
Randomized double-blind crossover study in healthy adults during sustained mental effort; acute mood/cognition effects with healthy-population and short-term boundaries.
16-week randomized trial in mild cognitive impairment; combination-only evidence with subgroup-limited memory/attention signals and no attribution to either ingredient alone.
2012 randomized-trial review; lower UTI risk in women with recurrent UTIs with substantial heterogeneity; prevention not active-infection treatment.
16-trial review of inorganic nitrate/beetroot juice; systolic-BP signal, diastolic null, short heterogeneous interventions and dose-response meta-regression kept together.
Earlier glycemic meta-analysis; glucose reductions concentrated in medium/high-dose diabetes trials with substantial heterogeneity; dose and disease status remain explicit.
17-trial BP meta-analysis; modest SBP/DBP reductions overall but systolic benefit concentrated in hypertensive rather than normotensive participants.
Clinical-trial meta-analysis finding reduced UTI incidence versus controls; prevention-only evidence with product heterogeneity.
Small meta-analysis of 180 participants reporting reduced upper-respiratory symptom severity; limited evidence base and no specific influenza-treatment claim.
2019 review showing possible lower URI risk but no convincing shortening of illness duration; varied preparations and selective-reporting concerns retained.
Umbrella meta-analysis documenting conflicting glycemic conclusions across prior cinnamon syntheses; explicit counterweight to a single efficacy label.
24-RCT T2D dose-response meta-analysis; fasting glucose/HbA1c signals with insulin null and substantial preparation/trial heterogeneity.
